description: This file defines a Perl package 'metadata' that provides functions and variables for parsing and managing package and target metadata, including reading metadata files, handling package dependencies, and managing user/group information.

methods.name: get_multiline
methods.description: Reads multiple lines from a file handle until a line starting with '@@' is encountered, concatenating lines with optional prefix.

methods.name: confstr
methods.description: Transforms a configuration string by replacing certain characters with underscores.

methods.name: parse_package_metadata_usergroup
methods.description: Parses user or group specifications from metadata, validating IDs and names, and updating corresponding hashes.

methods.name: parse_target_metadata
methods.description: Reads and parses target metadata from a file, extracting target properties, profiles, and dependencies.

methods.name: clear_packages
methods.description: Clears all package-related global hashes and arrays.

methods.name: parse_package_metadata
methods.description: Reads and parses detailed package metadata from a file, populating package, source, and category hashes.

methods.name: parse_package_manifest_metadata
methods.description: Reads and parses package manifest metadata from a file, populating package hashes.
